content: Customer Aarav Sharma acknowledges receipt of a policy renewal form from agent Suresh Deshmukh and commits to completing it immediately. The agent reminds the customer that the form is due tomorrow to reinstate the policy. Aarav inquires about the cause of the policy expiration, noting he did not recall receiving a renewal notice. The agent explains that a notice was sent via email on March 1st and may have been filtered into the spam folder, offering to resend it. Aarav requests a copy of the email and asks for confirmation that his policy number remains unchanged.

action_items: Customer to fill out and return the renewal form by tomorrow
Agent to send a copy of the renewal email to the customer
Agent to confirm the customer's policy number remains unchanged
